description: This file defines the CommonMarkConverter class within a Confluence content format for Markdown. It extends a base Markdown converter, configures a table of contents, heading permalinks, and custom renderers for various Markdown node types, including code blocks, images, links, and admonitions. It also extends the environment with additional extensions and renderers tailored for Confluence integration.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A custom Markdown converter for Confluence content, extending the base CommonMarkConverter to include extensions, custom renderers, and configuration specific to the Confluence format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the converter with configuration options, setting up table of contents positioning and heading permalink prefix, then calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Extends the Markdown environment by adding extensions and renderers for table of contents, permalinks, code blocks, images, links, and admonitions, enhancing the Markdown rendering capabilities for Confluence.
